title: Worshiping God Rightly
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Worshiping God rightly means responding to Him according to who He is and how He has revealed Himself. True worship is shaped by truth, reverence, love, obedience, and the glory of God.
summary: Worshiping God rightly means responding to Him according to who He is and how He has revealed Himself. True worship is shaped by truth, reverence, love, obedience, and the glory of God.
christFocus: Jesus Christ makes true worship possible by bringing sinners to the Father. Through Him, believers worship in Spirit and truth, giving glory to the triune God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God must be worshiped as He has revealed Himself, not as people imagine Him to be. Worship is not built on preference, entertainment, superstition, or human invention, but on the truth of God’s Word.

True worship includes reverence and love. God alone is worthy of ultimate devotion. His people must not bow to idols, rival gods, self-rule, or forms of worship that replace His glory with human desire.

Jesus teaches that true worshipers worship the Father in Spirit and truth. Worship is not limited to location, style, or outward form. It must come from hearts made alive by God and governed by His truth.

The whole Christian life becomes worship. Believers offer their bodies as living sacrifices, resisting conformity to the world and being transformed by the renewing of the mind.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Worship can easily become self-centered. People may ask first whether worship fits their taste, moves their emotions, displays their talent, or attracts a crowd. Scripture begins elsewhere: God is worthy.

This doctrine protects the church from shallow or false worship. The God who is a consuming fire must be approached with reverence, gratitude, truth, and faith in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture shape your worship of God. Sing, pray, serve, give, listen, obey, and live before Him with reverence and joy. Do not reduce worship to music or emotion. Offer your whole life to God through Christ in the power of the Spirit.
